review_policy: Manual visual review; generated-image pixel comparison is not a CI gate.
prompt_hash_policy: prompt_sha256 tracks the current compiler projection for source drift; an immutable execution prompt hash is stored in the public receipt when retained.
receipt_policy: A compiled spec with must_attach image inputs requires a sanitized public receipt; raw local runtime receipts remain uncommitted.
